explain.means: What this means: {{planet}} shows up mainly in {{house}}.
explain.exalted: It is very strong here, so these qualities come easily to you.
explain.debilitated: It is weaker here, so these qualities may need more conscious effort.
explain.own: It is comfortable in its own sign, so it works steadily for you.
explain.retro: Being retrograde, its results tend to come through reflection and second attempts.
explain.combust: Being close to the Sun, it can feel overshadowed by ego or authority figures.
explain.detail: {{planet}} at {{deg}}° in {{sign}}, house {{house}}, {{nakshatra}} nakshatra pada {{pada}}. Navamsa: {{navamsa}}.
explain.dasha: You are in a {{md}} period, with a {{ad}} sub-period. This phase highlights {{theme}}.
explain.manglik_yes: Mars sits where tradition says it can make relationships intense. It is very common (about 4 in 10 charts) and is usually discussed during Kundli matching — nothing to fear.
explain.manglik_cancelled: Mars is in a sensitive position, but its own strength cancels the dosha.
explain.kaalsarp_yes: All planets fall on one side of Rahu–Ketu. Tradition links this with ups and downs before steady success.

sadesati.title: Sade Sati & Dhaiya
sadesati.now_yes: Sade Sati is running for you now — {{phase}} phase, until {{date}}.
sadesati.now_dhaiya: Shani Dhaiya is running now ({{phase}}), until {{date}}.
sadesati.now_no: No Sade Sati or Dhaiya is running for you right now.
sadesati.what: Sade Sati is the roughly 7½ years when Shani (Saturn) moves through the sign before your Moon sign, your Moon sign, and the sign after it. Tradition sees it as a time of hard work, responsibility and growth — not something to fear.
sadesati.mean_rising: Changes begin, often around expenses, sleep and travel.
sadesati.mean_peak: The most demanding stretch: patience and steady effort bring results.
sadesati.mean_setting: Pressure eases; focus moves to money, family and speech.
sadesati.mean_kantak: About 2½ years needing care at home and with property.
sadesati.mean_ashtam: About 2½ years asking for caution with health habits and sudden changes.

consent.title: Before you begin
consent.intro: Taara needs a few permissions to work. Please read and choose.
consent.data_birth: Your birth details, to make your charts and readings.
consent.data_chat: Your chats, to give answers, translate and resolve complaints.
consent.data_palm: Palm photos, only for your palm reading. Never public; deleted after 12 months.
consent.data_share: Pandits see your birth details only if you choose to share them.
consent.data_ai: AI answers are created by our AI provider. We never sell your data.
consent.terms: I agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Notice, and I understand astrology is guidance, not a guarantee.
consent.marketing: Send me offers and festival updates.
consent.optional: Optional. You can change this any time in Notifications.
consent.under18_body: You need to be 18 or older to use Taara. Please ask a parent or guardian.
consent.withdraw: You can withdraw consent at any time from Profile → Privacy, including deleting your account.

safety.title: Help & Safety
safety.care_body: If you're going through something hard, please talk to someone now. These calls are free. This conversation will not be charged.
safety.report_hint: Tell us about billing errors, rude or unsafe behaviour, wrong answers or privacy concerns. We acknowledge every report immediately and resolve within 15 days.
safety.report_sent_body: Your reference number is {{ref}}. We'll update you within 15 days.
safety.block_body: They will disappear from your lists and can't be consulted again. The current chat ends now.
safety.long_press_report: Long press to report this message
safety.masked: Phone numbers, UPI IDs and links are hidden to keep you safe. Never pay outside Taara.
safety.chat_notice: For your safety, chats stay on Taara. Phone numbers, UPI IDs and links are hidden. Never pay a Pandit outside the app.
safety.tip_pay: Never pay a Pandit outside Taara, by UPI, bank transfer or cash.
safety.tip_contact: Don't share your phone number, address or social media in chats.
safety.tip_otp: Nobody from Taara will ever ask for your OTP, PIN or card details.
safety.tip_fear: No genuine astrologer will threaten you with curses or demand money for remedies. Report it.
safety.tip_medical: For health, legal or money problems, please see a qualified professional.
safety.grievance_sla: Complaints are acknowledged within 24 hours and resolved within 15 days.
